channel.title: Pukar Bhandari
channel.description: Pukar Bhandari is a Transportation Planner and Data Scientist working at the intersection of Transportation Modeling, Economic Impact Analysis, and Data Science.

item.title: An Education Explorer for Public NCES Data
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A static, map-first dashboard for publicly available NCES data (CCD, PSS, IPEDS) for one U.S. state at a time, powered by DuckDB-WASM.

item.title: A Zero-Cost Freight Flow Explorer for Utah
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A map-first explorer for the public Freight Analysis Framework (FAF) data, built as a static site that queries Parquet files directly in the browser.

item.title: Restyling Utah’s Vector Basemap for MapLibre
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Alternate MapLibre styles for UGRC’s Lite vector basemap, generated from live upstream sources, and a visual editor to tweak, compare and download them.

item.title: Borderline: A U.S. Geography Guessing Game
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A browser geography game for U.S. states and counties, built as plain static HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step.

item.title: Drut: Linting and Formatting for Cube Voyager Scripts
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Drut is a linter, formatter and editor tooling suite for Cube Voyager scripts (.s / .block), with a CLI, a language server for VS Code, and an MCP server.

item.title: GTFS vs. TDM Transit Network Comparison
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A web map for comparing the base-year transit network in the Wasatch Front travel demand model with GTFS transit data. Developed at the Wasatch Front Regional Council.

item.title: Commute Flow Explorer
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A client-side web app for exploring origin-destination commuter flows across the Wasatch Front using H3 cells and DuckDB-WASM. Developed at the Wasatch Front Regional Council.

item.title: Opportunity Zones 2.0 Tract Info Sheets
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A Quarto and R pipeline that builds county summary and per-tract detail PDFs for Utah’s Opportunity Zones 2.0 eligible list. Developed at the Wasatch Front Regional Council.

item.title: Utah Commuter Flow Patterns
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: An interactive, client-side map of commute flows across Utah, built on LEHD LODES data and open-source tools. Developed at the Wasatch Front Regional Council.

item.title: SE 2025 Urban Form D Variables (H3)
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Calculates the D variables of urban form (density, diversity, design, destinations, demographics, distance to transit) for the Wasatch Front region at H3 resolution. Developed at the Wasatch Front Regional Council.

item.title: Building a Client-Side Geo/Parquet File Viewer
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Want a quick way to preview what is inside your parquet file? This is a browser-based, zero-backend viewer for Parquet and GeoParquet, built on DuckDB-WASM. Nothing is uploaded; everything runs locally in your tab.

item.title: Building a Client-Side Open Matrix (OMX) File Viewer
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: I spent way too long writing one-off Python scripts everytime I had to check what’s inside an OMX (Open Matrix Format) file. There had to be a better way.

item.title: Spatial Explorer: Spatial SQL for Maps, in the Browser and in VS Code
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Open a geospatial file, query it with spatial SQL, style it and export it without a desktop GIS. How the project grew from a single-page experiment into a web app and a VS Code extension.

item.title: WgetGUI Ultimate: A Fluent Command Generator
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A modern, Windows 11-inspired web interface for building complex GNU Wget commands

item.title: Housing Site Evaluator
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Scores every parcel and H3 hexagon in the Wasatch Front region on access to jobs, transit and everyday necessities. Developed at the Wasatch Front Regional Council.

item.title: Building an Interactive Storymap using {mapgl}
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: Creating an open-source, interactive storymap with the {mapgl} R package to visualize my journey across the world.

item.title: Base Year SE Data Development
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: This section establishes the computational environment for processing socioeconomic data inputs for the Lower Savannah Council of Governments regional travel demand model using both R and Python platforms.

item.title: Building an Interactive Population Pyramid Explorer
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A deep dive into creating a story-driven Shiny application that combines interactive mapping with demographic visualizations using Census data.

item.title: Interactive Robocopy GUI Tool
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: A web-based interface for generating Windows robocopy commands with ease

item.title: pukRhelpers: A Personal Toolbox of R Helpers
item.dc:creator: Pukar Bhandari
item.description: An R package collecting helper functions from my day-to-day data and GIS work. Maintained lightly.
